hero.title: Minseok Song
hero.subtitle: Deep Tech & Semiconductor Technology Strategist | Ex-Research Appointments @ KAIST NNFC & KRISS

blocks.title: Operating Thesis
blocks.body: My goal is to be a Deep Tech & Semiconductor Technology Strategist—bridging cleanroom fabrication realities, AI architectures, and commercial feasibility into actionable product roadmaps.

blocks.title: Lead
blocks.body: I am a Deep Tech & Semiconductor Technology Strategist with hands-on cleanroom fabrication and AI research experience at KAIST NNFC and KRISS. I specialize in turning complex physics constraints and emerging AI systems into commercially deployable product roadmaps.

blocks.title: Body 1
blocks.body: My strategy combines technical depth with market feasibility. From self-filing multi-agent AI patents (10-2026-0009508) to architecting recipe automation modules tailored to 183 cleanroom tool specifications at KAIST NNFC, I focus on bridging internal fab realities with scalable product value.

blocks.title: Body 2
blocks.body: At KRISS, I spearheaded high-accuracy ultrasonic velocity metrology for non-invasive sensing as 1st author. Across national competitions, I led unit-cost modeling, public patent commercialization, and market-entry roadmaps—winning Grand Prize (CNU) and 5 Special Awards for strategic execution.
